'''High Acquisitors''' was a rank held by certain members of the [[Chevin Conglomerate]] by the time of the post-[[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era. Several Chevin High Acquisitors were meeting at [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in secret during the [[Grand Acquisitions Race]]. It was suspected by [[Gyden Kall]] that perhaps they believed the [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler's]] Moon was safe from spies.
